Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, one of the best times we ever had was when we built that rollercoaster. (pauses) We should do it again! But this time...as a musical! Whaddya say? We'll do all the same things, except we'll break into spontaneous singing and choreography with no discernible music source!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hmm...what assurance would we have that everyone else would also break into song and do the same thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. I think they probably will.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Fair enough. I'm in.

Name: Background Singers
Dialog: Boredom is something up with which I will not put!

Name: Background Singers
Dialog: Boredom is something up with which I will not put!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb! I'm gonna go pick up a few things. You boys stay out of trouble, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm in charge, right? You did tell them I'm in charge.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Relax, Candace. Nobody has to be in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But what if there's an emergency?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if, uh... What if a wild moose, a whole herd of them, burst into the house and attack everyone?

Name: Linda
Dialog: If that happens, you're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom says I'm in charge...conditionally.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The condition didn't have anything to do with a moose, did it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know it's funny that you mention that...oh! (Realizing she is getting distracted) I'm watching you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? Oh, hi, Stacy! Mom just went to the store, she left me charge, well, you know, conditionally.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, that's better than not in charge at all, I guess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's all about the varying degrees of authority. There's conditionally in charge; and you've got your basically in charge, your mostly in charge; and then there's just in charge, completely devoid of modifiers. That's what I'm shooting for. Huh? What are my brothers doing right now? What do you mean you can see it from where you are? See what?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out, Ferb. We can see Stacy's house from here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, what is this?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I'm gonna tell Mom, and when she sees what you're doing, you are going down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (You're going down)...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Ferb) See? No discernible music source.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Candace. Hi, Stacy. Hey Jenny. How'd the number go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pretty good, but I'm still angry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I guess I'm up. (walks to the gate)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And say...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a roller coaster.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Again? Cool. (At Ferb) Hey, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Still a man of few words, I see.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, you missed it. Earlier he had two lines.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, chatty.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons unknown to us, he's bought up 80% of the country's tin foil. (He stops, looking a bit surprised) Carl, di-didn't he already do that?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Yes, sir. At the beginning of summer.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well, all right then. Uh, Agent P, go out there and do the same thing you did last time.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, Agent P. Ah, the world of a field agent, out in the thick of things. Not like me.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Oh, sorry, sir. I thought you were done. You want me to turn 'em back on?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Nah, forget it. The moment's gone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So the way I see it, the solid fuel rockets kick in at the mall parking lot. Then we release the snakes during the corkscrew around the interstate. I'm gonna go get some snakes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've gotta come home right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let me guess, a herd of wild moose are in our living room?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. Besides, it's mooses.

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, I think the word "moose" is already plural.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, trust me, it's mooses...or meese. Do you want me to get a dictionary?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is this what you came down here for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom! You've gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing! They're a building a roller coaster!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you've already used that one.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I didn't see it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I didn't see it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now, Candace...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, seriously, isn't Phineas a little young to be a roller coaster engineer?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yes. Yes, he is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But if I'm pressed,

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, it's true.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, I should really write the rest of that someday.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what a surprise. And by surprise, I mean not a surprise at all. Anyway, let me show you what I've been working on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha! I, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, have covered the entire eastern seaboard in tin foil...again. But this time when I put my giant magnet next to my ingenious Magnetism Magnifinator, I will pull the East in a westerly direction, thereby reversing rotation of the Earth! I-I know I tried this before but that was with a Magnifier this is a Magnifinator. I added the suffix –inator. It's a completely different ball game. I know you're probably expecting some tragic back story, to explain why I want to reverse the rotation of the Earth. But I'm not gonna go there. You know why? Well, I'll tell ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I don't!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Background Dancer
Dialog: Um so, are we done? 'Cause I gotta pick up my kid from school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One second, just wait 'til it goes to black.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (during black screen) All right, now you can go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, I'm telling you, they're building it, and it's huge!

Name: Linda
Dialog: And I'm telling you, you've used this story before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but this time, it's a musical!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Phineas and Ferb present the Coolest Coaster Ever, now open"? Mom!

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Hey look, the Coolest Coaster Ever! You think we'll get in free with this poster?

Name: Another Kid
Dialog: We didn't last time. Maybe we should take it just in case.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, if anyone's gonna ride this thing, it's gonna be me. Not one of you lousy extras.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here, look, look, look, look, look, see? I told you I'm not crazy! I told you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: And you're not crazy because...?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I see your point, Candace. No crazy person would scream at a post like that. I'll be in the dairy section if you want to come yell at some cheese. (leaves, but comes back) Would you like that, honey? Would you like to yell at some cheese?

Name: Candace
Dialog: A little.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, c'mon, then.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I hope Agent P is having good luck like I told him to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, children of all ages! May I present to you a spectacle most of the morning in the making! Mark your calendars because you will want to tell your grandchildren about the day you rode...the Coolest...Coaster...EVER!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And this time it's a musical.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: To fasten, insert the tab into the metal buckle. To release, just pull back on the -- (He drops the seat belt.) Oops.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (a bit scared) Phineas, are you sure this is safe?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's right!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look out!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm glad I'm wearing trousers

Name: Buford
Dialog: That are already brown!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got the poster!

Dialog: And then there's that whole economic downturn and I'm left holding a 300K house in a 10K neighborhood. My accountant just wants me to walk away from it, I'm like, I can't do that. Just because I'm evil doesn't mean I don't care about my credit rating

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! You missed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaahh! Ow, ow, ow, ow, owww!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you walked all the way to the service station to get the jumper cables, but you didn't bring the battery cart. What did you think a battery cart was just going to fall out of the sky?

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: Okay. (smiles hopefully) What did you think a million dollars was just going to fall out of the sky?

Name: Farmer
Dialog: It doesn't work that way.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: Well, how does it work then?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, you are too late! (He pulls a lever, activating the Magnetism Magnifinator) Quake in your boots and watch helplessly as the unimaginable electromagnetic forces, pull the eastern seaboard, thereby reversing rotation of the--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that didn't work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now we have a two-ton ball of tin foil traveling two hundred miles an hour directly at us! Quickly, we must separate the magnet from the Magnifinator before it is too late!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is it just me or is this a serious déjà vu moment? I-I feel like I've totally been here before. Like you were there, the tin foil was coming, and I- "Quickly, we must separate the magnet". E-e-eh. Huh. Oh, well, weird. Where was I? Oh yeah. Aaaahhh! (Resumes trying to move the Magnifinator)

Name: Woman
Dialog: Man, is she mad at that cheese

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute. What's going on out there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh! Mom?! Mom!?! (She runs back inside.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's no use! We are doomed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You did it! You saved us, Perry the Platypus! You sa—again, again with the déjà vu. You were up there, I was saying, "You saved us." And then, hm, and then something came from– (The tin foil ball crashes into the building) Curse you, déjà vu!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, look, look, see?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pause) Okay, I give up. What am I supposed to be looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! It's not possible!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm gonna go get the cart.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was right here, and it was huge! (She sees the roller coaster being carried away by the helicopter.) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Time to go. I've got frozens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, so you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, yes. That would be my guess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine, then. Let's go home, now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice hat, Isabella.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Funny, I don't remember this in the blueprint.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And I'm sure this is new.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I worry about you sometimes, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, if they break into our house, Candace is in charge.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Phineas. Anyone want any fries?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, we're good.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, say hi to your sister for me!

Name: French Man
Dialog: Crêpe, Suzette?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you say, Suzette? You want a crêpe?

Name: Suzette
Dialog: No, thank you.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap.

Dialog: It was good to see Meap.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, we're here. Are you happy now, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! (To Linda) See, Mom? I told you they weren't there!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh hi, boys. (At this point, Candace opens her eyes and her mood changes to shock.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, Candace, help me with the groceries.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but, but, but, but-- (continues under)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let's go. (She pulls her away)

Name: Kid
Dialog: Hey, Phineas, that was great!

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Way too cool!

Name: Third Kid
Dialog: That was awesome! Can we do it again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, only one ride per customer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was great, Phineas! So, what are you gonna do tomorrow?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you know what they say: carpe diem.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Excuse me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Carpe diem. It's Latin for "seize the day".

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or you could say "seize the day" was English for "carpe diem".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, you could.

Dialog: Okay, people, that was fabulous, but I want to work on one thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, world renowned choreographer, Kenny Ortega!

Name: Kenny Ortega
Dialog: Thanks, Phineas. All right, everyone, in this last chorus, let's really hit that straight arm like this. Okay? Straight arm on both sides. Alright now, performance level. Five, six, seven, eight!

Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, c'mon, sir.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: No, Carl. The moment is gone.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I got cut off twice already.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) But, sir, you're very good.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I am?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, sir. I've heard you practice.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well um, I have been practicing.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, sir. And just like the song says, carpe diem.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well, you can't argue with Latin, can you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) No, you can't, sir.

Dialog: Alrighty then. (He clears his throat)

Dialog: Oh, come on!
